title: Zero Trust Branch Appliances Wall and Rack Mount Instruction Manual

blocks.text: After you receive the Zscaler Zero Trust Branch appliance, you can mount the Zero Trust Branch appliance as follows:

blocks.item: The Zero Trust Branch ZT400: Rack posts using the rack mount kit. (Only available by request.)
The Zero Trust Branch ZT600: Rack posts using the rack mount kit.
Rack posts using the rack mount kit.
To the wall, using the wall mount kit. (Only available by request.)
The Zero Trust Branch ZT8010: Rack posts using the ear brackets.

blocks.text: Mounting on a rack or wall optimizes your workspace and makes your Zero Trust Branch appliance more accessible for installation and deployment. It protects your appliance from any external damage and helps streamline the organization of your cables and power adapters. Additionally, rack or wall mounting helps ensure proper airflow, preventing overheating and dust accumulation caused by restricted ventilation. Proper airflow also maintains a cleaner environment, prolonging the lifespan of the appliance.
The following table provides the environmental and power specifications for Zero Trust Branch appliances:

blocks.item: Zero Trust Branch ZT400 Instruction Manual
The package includes the following items:
The rack mount kit is available only by request.
3x A screws for attaching the bracket to the appliance
4x B screws for mounting the appliance on the rack
To rack mount your Zero Trust Branch ZT400:
Place the appliance in the middle of the rack mounting bracket with the appliance's rear panel facing away from the bracket.
On the back of the mount, secure the appliance to the rack mounting bracket with three screws.
Turn over the appliance and rack mounting bracket and place the power adapter next to the appliance, in the adapter holder section.
Secure the power adapter with two zip ties. Secure the cables with one zip tie.
Attach the power adapter connector to the appliance's rear panel.

Hold the appliance and lift carefully to insert the appliance into the rack. Zscaler recommends installing a shelf in the rack to support the appliance. Attach the brackets to the rail rack using rack mounting screws.
Connect the necessary cables to the designated ports of the appliance. To learn more, see Zero Trust Branch Physical Port Mapping.
Zero Trust Branch ZT600 Instruction Manual
The package includes the following items:
6x A screws for attaching the brackets to the appliance
To rack mount the Zero Trust Branch ZT600:
Align one rack mounting bracket to the screw holes on the side panel of the appliance and attach the bracket using three A screws.
Secure the other rack mounting bracket to the other side of the appliance.
Ensure that the adapter's cable is connected and secured.

Hold the appliance and lift carefully to insert the appliance into the rack. Zscaler recommends installing a shelf in the rack to support the appliance. Attach the brackets to the rail rack using rack mounting screws.
Connect the necessary cables to the designated ports of the appliance. To learn more, see Zero Trust Branch Physical Port Mapping.
Zero Trust Branch ZT800 Instruction Manual
The package includes the following items:
6x A screws for attaching the brackets to the appliance
The wall mount kit is available only by request.
To wall mount the Zero Trust Branch ZT800:
Turn the appliance over and attach the wall brackets onto the bottom side of the appliance. Secure with the 4x B screws provided for mounting.
On the wall, measure the exact place where you want to mount the appliance. Drill four holes that align with the four mounting holes on the brackets.
Insert the four white wall plugs into the holes you drilled into the wall.
Insert the long screws into the wall plugs.
Align the four screw holes on the appliance's wall brackets with the four long screws installed on the wall.
Secure the four screws in the bracket holes and push the appliance downward to lock the screws into position.
Connect the necessary cables to the designated ports of the appliance. To learn more, see Zero Trust Branch Physical Port Mapping.
To rack mount the Zero Trust Branch ZT800:
Align one rack mounting bracket to the screw holes on the side panel of the appliance and secure the bracket using three A screws.
Secure the other rack mounting bracket to the other side of the appliance.
Ensure that the adapter's cable is connected and secured.

Hold the appliance and lift carefully to insert the appliance into the rack. Zscaler recommends installing a shelf in the rack to support the appliance. Attach the brackets to the rail rack using rack mounting screws.
Connect the necessary cables to the designated ports of the appliance. To learn more, see Zero Trust Branch Physical Port Mapping.
Zero Trust Branch ZT8010 Instruction Manual
The package includes the following items:
6x A screws for attaching the brackets to the appliance
6x B screws for mounting the appliance to the rack
To rack mount the Zero Trust Branch ZT8010:
Align one of the ear brackets to screw holes on the side of the chassis and secure the bracket using 3x A screws.
Secure the other ear bracket to the other side of the appliance.
Insert the PSUs. The appliance supports redundant power supply units (PSUs).
Insert the ZT8010 appliance into the rack with the ear brackets fixed on the posts using the 4x B screws provided for mounting.
The method and parts required for mounting depend on whether a shelf or rail kit is used.
Connect both PSUs with their respective power sources.

A continuous beep indicates that either the second power source is unplugged or faulty. To silence the beep, press the round button located near or between the power supplies, or connect the second power source.

Connect the WAN cable to the designated port of the ZT8010 appliance. The ZT8010 has several ports, including 10x 1GbE RJ45 ports and 8x 10G SFP+ ports. To learn more, see Zero Trust Branch Physical Port Mapping.
